record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only the HSTU attention branch gate from value*SiLU(gate) to value*sigmoid(gate), retaining the existing projections, causal attention, residual paths and FFN. Bounded positive gating may stabilize attention updates and reduce amplification from extreme gate activations. Keep embeddings, features, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed; use the identical block in the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Use bounded sigmoid gating in every HSTU attention block across all four category models to reduce extreme gate amplification. Preserve projections, attention, residual paths, FFN, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so it automatically uses the identical updated architecture with unchanged checkpoint shapes.
